notes.title: Better Aim Helpers Update
notes.content:
[p][i]The Book of Aaru[/i] is a challenging roguelite, as it should be. But we also know that not everyone is looking for a try-hard experience. Some of you are here to enjoy the rich Egyptian Sci-fi world we've built, and want to let that sink in without the roguelite struggles.[/p][p]To support a wider range of playstyles, we've always offered two aim-related helpers in combat: [b]Aim-Assist[/b] and [b]Lock-On Target[/b]. Now, with this update, we're making them more accessible, better explained, and easier to manage during gameplay.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]How Do These Systems Work?[/h3][p][b]Aim-Assist[/b] is designed as a [i]quality of life[/i] feature. It’s for players who want to stay in control of their aiming but wouldn’t mind a little help. With this option enabled, you still control rotation manually, but if your aim drifts slightly off target, within a small angle tolerance, the system gently nudges your attack back toward the enemy.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/ec4e5750b2f2d0337d99568bb3e858595a731c52.png"][/img] [/p][p]Under the hood, this uses two invisible cones:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]tight cone[/b] that confirms you’re aiming closely enough to “attach” to an enemy.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A [b]wider cone[/b] that helps reattach your aim if you momentarily slip off target after already locking on.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/6c60b91c793234e85a53a66e17125ed57e95d26c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Lock-On Target[/b], on the other hand, is a more powerful assist, which completely lowers the difficulty of the game. It fully takes over your character’s rotation and always focuses on the nearest enemy, letting you concentrate purely on dodging and attacking. You can manually cycle through enemies as well, giving you full control over who to target next.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/03f004c5eb1448bd51d7d974db984d29754866e5.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]What’s New in This Update?[/h3][p]The most important change: [b]clarity and accessibility.[/b][/p][p]Until now, many players weren’t aware these features even existed in the tutorial, it was easy to miss how to interact with these features. With this update:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]first time you plug in a controller[/b], a pop-up explains both aim helpers and asks if you'd like to enable Lock-On by default or opt for a more challenging experience without it.[/p][/*][*][p]Once you make a choice, the game remembers your preferred default and automatically reapplies it whenever a level is loaded - even if you accidentally switched it mid-combat.[/p][/*][*][p]You can toggle either system [b]on or off at any time[/b] during battle temporarily.[/p][/*][*][p]You can also change your [b]default aim setting permanently[/b] via the controls options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]And for extra clarity, we’ve added [b]new HUD icons[/b] that clearly show whether Aim-Assist or Lock-On Target is currently active all the time.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Got Feedback?[/h3][p]We’d love to hear what you think! If you have questions, suggestions, or want to share how the new system feels, drop a comment below or join the conversation on our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/UV72k3h7hy"]https://discord.gg/UV72k3h7hy[/url].
[/p][p][b]Thank you for playing, and good luck fighting off waves of demonic foes![/b][/p]

tags.feature: To support a wider range of playstyles, we've always offered two aim-related helpers in combat: [b]Aim-Assist[/b] and [b]Lock-On Target[/b]. Now, with this update, we're making them more accessible, better explained, and easier to manage during gameplay.
The first time you plug in a controller, a pop-up explains both aim helpers and asks if you'd like to enable Lock-On by default or opt for a more challenging experience without it.
Once you make a choice, the game remembers your preferred default and automatically reapplies it whenever a level is loaded - even if you accidentally switched it mid-combat.
You can toggle either system [b]on or off at any time[/b] during battle temporarily.
You can also change your [b]default aim setting permanently[/b] via the controls options menu.
And for extra clarity, we’ve added [b]new HUD icons[/b] that clearly show whether Aim-Assist or Lock-On Target is currently active all the time.

notes.title: Third Patch! v1.1.2 – Wall Escape Fixes & Better Parry
notes.content:
[p]This update focuses on tightening level design and improving the overall feel of combat. We've gone through all core scenes to reinforce boundaries, polish gameplay feedback, and make the early game experience a bit more forgiving, especially when it comes to parrying. 
[/p][h2]Feature Improvements[/h2][h2]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/3ad53789ccd2a7f5a12ae7fa0d5c4823cfe2a246.png"][/img][/h2][h3]Scene Fixes & Wall Prevention[/h3][p]We have created a tool that lets us scan a scene and map out zones, based on weather they are covered by walls of sufficient height. Thanks to that, we were able to focus on preventing players from escaping the intended walkable areas and falling out of the world. Here’s what’s been addressed: [/p][list][*][p]All known spots where players could climb over walls and leave the map have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Every main scene has been reviewed and updated with [b]extra preventive measures[/b] to block unintended exits.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: Sandstorm-level scenes will receive the same treatment in an upcoming patch.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Destroyable objects placed on walls will now drop their materials [b]next to[/b] the wall instead of [b]on top[/b], to prevent loot from getting stuck.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Certain cliffs, walls, and other big objects do not properly interact with projectiles[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Minor object placement tweaks, added decorations, or overall small prop adjustments[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/d85c2887460cff227cd0cd88dab071f0e09cbf8a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Combat Polish - Parry Improvements[/h3][p]We’ve overhauled the parry system to better support learning and make early-game fights less punishing:[/p][list][*][p]Parrying now [b]always provides some form of damage protection[/b], even on imperfect timing.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]successful parry[/b] now grants a short [b]invulnerability window[/b], in addition to deflecting the attack and stunning enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New Visual Feedback - Heavy Attack Charging[/h3][p]We’ve added a [b]new on-screen effect[/b] when charging up heavy attacks to help communicate timing and intention.[/p][p][/p][p]📢 [b]We need your feedback![/b][/p][list][*][p]Is the effect [b]too distracting[/b]?[/p][/*][*][p]Is it [b]barely visible[/b] on your screen or device?
Let us know - we want to fine-tune this visual until it feels [i]just right[/i].[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Minor localization corrections.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all for your continued support and feedback. As always, feel free to share your thoughts in the comments or over on our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/UV72k3h7hy"]https://discord.gg/UV72k3h7hy[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][b]See you in the Temple![/b][/p]

notes.title: First week Patch! v1.1
notes.content:
After the first week after release, we are coming with a big patch addressing the most important issues.
You've shared your feedback, and we have listened. We care about your experience, so we introduce the following fix and polish list:

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Glyphs no longer lose their ability when crossing between levels
[*] Chinese fonts in-game are no longer substituted by placeholder symbols
[*] Ensured that the order of looted Supportive Gear and Glyphs is truly random
[*] Purple light fragments around Attribute Altars removed
[*] Fixed issue in Dungeon Caves of Despair arena where enemies were able to go through rollable bar
[*] Fixed issue in Dungeon Temple of Discovery corridor where fireball traps were unable to shoot over low walls
[*] Fixed replacement confirmation text where the new and old item order was reversed
[*] Typo corrections in dialogues
[*] Visiting secret dimension no longer breaks the ability of Time Bending or Medallion activation
[*] End credits name corrections
[*] Dagger and Shakram recipe no longer unlocks Staff of Madness, but itself
[*] Supportive Gear and Glyph replacement cancellation can no longer softlock the player in the Equipment menu UI
[*] Some Glyphs were fixed to work as intended based on their descriptions (for example, Challenge from Seth)
[*] Dropped Crafting Schematics corrected interaction UI
[*] Stats about collected Shards now appear correctly in the Death and Victory stat screens
[*] The Book of Aaru crafting UI menu no longer closes on "Back" prompt on controller
[/list]
[h2]Feature Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Indicator for insufficient material amounts in The Book of Aaru station
[*] Prevention against inserting materials into negative values
[*] More explanations for the blessing of materials
[*] More hints about blessing added to loading screens
[*] Discarding Supportive Gear or Glyphs is now animated in the UI to indicate the action was successful
[*] Lowered material costs of some items in The Book of Aaru station
[*] Caterpillar explosion collider lifespan reduced
[*] Boss fights were balanced according to players’ endgame character
[*] Bosses now have more health
[*] Shaman's Buds also have more health
[*] Boss phases now actually reflect events occurring during the boss fight
[*] Bosses now visually spawn reward materials instead of awarding them behind the scenes
[*] Equipment menu slot level indicators improved for better clarity - Support Gear and Glyph connections now stay visible and bullet points reflect the correct level of the slot
[/list]
[h2]Polish:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Level exit cinematic visual improvements
[*] Better lighting in the Shard stage of the Tutorial
[*] Health Altar is now animated to indicate it was used and cannot be used again
[*] If the HUD cannot find the appropriate icon for a rebound input, a default icon will appear
[*] Better distinction between highlighted and selected slots during looting in the Equipment menu
[*] Polished legend for crafting in The Book of Aaru station for controllers
[/list]

We will continue to improve and support the game further!

notes.title: Home Sweet Tomb
notes.content:
Every hero needs a home base. In the new Bastion update, Emily’s once-ruined outpost becomes a cozy, customizable refuge between expeditions. Picture the sun setting over distant pyramids as a vortex of stars swirls overhead – this is your canvas. Now you can spend your hard-won materials to renovate the Bastion: tile its floors, hang richly dyed rugs, set lanterns ablaze, and even erect statues or alcoves. Each item not only makes the Bastion more inviting, but also tells a story of your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/fef4b005826ca1a190feaa965a5ac7e8b7586df7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/cfbf53b626c839dcf45998c16e77822351bcd988.png[/img]
This mirrors the heart of The Book of Aaru — an isometric rogue-lite set in an evolved ancient Egypt, blending myth and sci-fi with procedurally generated dungeons, handcrafted traps, and rhythmic dual-wielding combat. You survive the chaos, and now you get to shape the calm.

[b]How It Works[/b]
The Bastion remains your non-combat hub — but now it’s also a late-game system with real utility:

[list]
[*] [b]Decorate your sanctuary[/b] with tile floors, glowing braziers, ornate rugs, and ancient columns.

[*] [b]Spend leftover materials[/b] from your expeditions to build decorations and clean up the ruins.

[*] [b]Get rewarded in return[/b] by scavenging leftover scrap from old furnishings — converting low-value materials into more useful ones.
[/list]
This turns your safe zone into a strategic exchange system, letting you fine-tune your inventory and make the place your own. It's not just meta-progression — it’s personal.

[b]Watch the Transformation[/b]
See how your Bastion could transform in our latest video:
[previewyoutube=3ZAAwGWCVwc;full][/previewyoutube]
From rubble to resting place, watch the changes unfold with each placed object and flickering fire.

[b]Your Bastion, Your Way[/b]
Check also fresh screenshots showing Bastion upgrade steps. Rugs? Sure. Floors? Of course. Glowing alien-tech obelisks? Maybe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/0c4dec3a87766685132d49d033200776fb78d91d.png[/img]

[b]Ready to build the Bastion you deserve?
Add The Book of Aaru to your wishlist and be among the first to step inside![/b]

notes.title: From Generic to Gorgeous
notes.content:
As we get closer to the end of development and the game's release, we're focusing on polishing every aspect of The Book of Aaru. Today, we showcase a complete rework of our roll dash ability's visual effects!

This action-packed adventure in an evolved Egypt is shaping up to be something special.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/fbb1deab84baada8c70fdc58f802d4279cbec44c.png[/img]
We've listened to your feedback and felt it was time for a change for several key reasons:

[b]Fresh from Our Workshop:[/b] The previous visual effect wasn't originally created by our team; it was a purchased asset. We're committed to bringing you a truly unique and cohesive experience, crafted entirely in-house as we head towards launch. This isometric rogue-lite set in an evolved ancient Egypt deserves our personal touch.

[b]Thematic Consistency:[/b] We felt the old "bubble" visual didn't quite align with the mystical and lore-rich atmosphere of our blend of Egyptian mythology and advanced sci-fi. It inadvertently detracted from the intended impact and feel of the ability as we finalize the game's presentation in this alternate 1926 Egypt with the mysterious tale of Emily Sands.

[b]Clarity and Gameplay Differentiation:[/b] This is a crucial improvement as we refine gameplay for release. We needed a clearer visual distinction to communicate the different functionalities of the roll ability depending on the environment within our procedurally generated dungeons with handcrafted traps.

[list]
[*] [i][b]In Arenas:[/b][/i] The roll now visually emphasizes its powerful defensive capabilities. It acts as an immortality dash, providing a temporary window of invulnerability, protecting you from all incoming damage in these dynamic combat arenas. Expect strategic and dynamic boss fights that will test your mastery of movement.

[*] [i][b]In Corridors:[/b][/i] The visual feedback for the roll in these areas will clearly indicate its primary function as a mobility tool, allowing for swift movement without the defensive properties it offers in combat arenas within these labyrinths filled with traps. Navigate these dangerous paths with hidden treasures in dynamically changing dungeons wisely.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/72d901f65483ab2570c6ae167d541199eb23e536.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/c5c2b40862d7d7506909c257ef5304724c652a94.png[/img]
We believe these new visuals will not only enhance the aesthetic appeal of Book of Aaru as we approach release but also provide crucial gameplay information at a glance, allowing for more strategic and intuitive use of the roll ability in our dynamic dual-wielding combat and combo attacks. Players will find this crucial for survival and utilizing the rhythmic combat with time-slowing mechanics effectively. This also ties into our active meta-progression and glyph upgrade system, allowing for deeper character customization.

[b]Stay tuned for more updates as we finalize development![/b]

notes.title: New Menace Slithers into the Caves of Despair!
notes.content:
Prepare to adapt, adventurers, in The Book of Aaru, a thrilling roguelite action experience!

[b]A new threat has burrowed its way into the depths of Dungeon II: the Larvae, also known as the Caterpillar, has arrived![/b] These creatures, once simple borers, have evolved into a dangerous foe capable of reshaping the very battlefield in this unique isometric adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/ddd2f72912e69261eff7dc4c88c530b31ac4c7c7.gif[/img]

[i][b]Lore and Behavior[/b][/i]
[i]The Larvae were once humble creatures, slowly etching their way through stone with acidic secretions. Now, they've become a hazardous presence in the Caves of Despair. While relatively weak in terms of health, their offensive capabilities are not to be underestimated in this fusion of Egypt and sci-fi.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/b9957703d48f463822a19f9ce71cd12d0b1e6113.png[/img]

[b]Key Features[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Environmental Hazard:[/b] The Larvae's primary attack involves launching a projectile of acidic venom. This leaves a trail of hazardous goo that lingers for 15 seconds, creating dynamic and ever-changing combat zones. This adds to the traps and challenges of the procedurally generated dungeons that are a core part of the game. No two encounters will ever be the same!

[*] [b]Explosive Demise:[/b] When near death, the Larvae undergoes a violent transformation. Its insides seem to turn inside out, causing it to convulse and roll erratically before exploding. This adds a strategic layer to combat: do you eliminate it from afar, or risk a close-quarters detonation, and use your dual-wielding and combo attacks?
[/list]

[b]Tactical Considerations[/b]
Unlike its robotic companions, the Mechanical Beetle and the Furious Hornet, the Larvae's explosive death may make it a priority to eliminate last. Consider your positioning and weapon choices carefully, as a well-timed detonation can turn the tide of battle. 

[b]Get ready to face this new challenge in the Caves of Despair![/b]

notes.title: YOU ASKED FOR IT!
notes.content:
[b]Two Unique Ways to Restore Your Health in this Isometric Rogue-Lite Set in an Evolved Ancient Egypt
[/b]
In battle, even the toughest heroes need a moment to recover. That's why we're thrilled to introduce two distinct healing altars to The Book of Aaru, each with its strategic considerations, adding another layer of depth to this action-packed adventure:

[b]The Grand Altar of Horus:[/b] This majestic altar, adorned with the falcon god's likeness, restores a significant chunk of your health (20%). However, it's hidden away in a secret dimension. You'll need a special key to access it, and you'll want to think carefully before using it – other dimensions hold different rewards, and topping off your health might not always be the best choice. This strategic element adds to the challenge of navigating the procedurally generated dungeons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/2d212100dc06d1db3668fbc76b44a71182313e59.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/8c33420c9faa3bc2d11ff6ed409d95618a945269.png[/img]
[b]The Lesser Altar of Thoth:[/b] Keep an eye out for these subtle altars scattered throughout the dungeon. Each one heals a small amount (5%) of your health, and you'll likely stumble upon several during your run. Beware - they are often concealed in shadows, making each reward truly earned. They can be found in trap-filled corridors, enemy-packed arenas, and other unexpected places. These labyrinths, filled with traps and dynamic combat arenas, demand constant vigilance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/2ff63e0773651100945807342c63a166b3c770cd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/81855f6901d7337e4eea67b405d695bcb2cab460.png[/img]
[b]Tips for Finding and Using Altars[/b]

[list]
[*] [i][b]Listen Carefully:[/b][/i] These altars emit a faint, mysterious sound. Train your ear to recognize it, and you'll be able to track them down even when they're hidden from view.

[*] [b][i]Adapt to the Dungeon:[/i][/b] Unlike Treasures, the locations of Lesser Altars change with each new dungeon generation. You'll need to stay sharp and explore thoroughly every time.

[*] [i][b]Seek Guidance:[/b][/i] The Seeker's Medallion can point you toward important locations in the dungeon, including healing altars. Craft and activate it to illuminate the path to crucial resources, including healing altars, granting you a tactical advantage.

[*] [i][b]Enhance Your Healing:[/b][/i] Discover glyphs that can boost the power of healing altars, making them even more effective. This ties into the active meta-progression system.
[/list]
[b]The Book of Aaru: Where Every Run is a New Challenge[/b]

Dive into the ever-changing world of The Book of Aaru, where fast-paced dual-wielding combat and combo attacks meet rogue-lite progression. With the addition of healing altars, you'll have even more strategic options as you battle through hordes of enemies and uncover the secrets of this evolved ancient Egypt, a blend of Egyptian mythology and advanced sci-fi.

notes.title: Illuminating the Depths of Aaru: Part II
notes.content:
In our ongoing quest to create the most immersive and atmospheric dungeon-crawling experience, we're thrilled to unveil the next chapter in the visual evolution of The Book of Aaru. Building upon the foundation laid in our previous update, we've introduced a suite of new lighting and rendering techniques that further enhance the game's visual fidelity and realism.

[b]Advanced Reflection and Refraction: [/b]Our new reflection and refraction system, which utilizes reflection and light probes, allows surfaces to interact with light in a more realistic and believable way. This creates a more connected and cohesive environment, as light bounces and reflects off of various surfaces, creating a sense of depth and realism. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/2a0215edd30bf7e456bd09cbc8f713f7629d604f.png[/img]
[b]Dynamic Shadows: [/b]Every object in the world now casts dynamic shadows, creating a more realistic and believable environment. Our lighting system has been optimized to allow for real-time shadow calculations, ensuring that shadows move and react to the player's actions and the environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/e5d5a4fe900c062826882d19aaa9ef97c3beb425.png[/img]
[b]Ambient Lighting: [/b]We've added subtle ambient lighting into the surroundings to create a more captivating experience. These soft, diffused lights, which lack a clear source, help to set the mood and guide the player's eye through the environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/4a9a99d9c84397a6eb9b7afcb2a806e432406c79.png[/img]
[b]Enhanced Emissive Materials: [/b]Objects with emissive materials, such as dangerous traps or magical artifacts, now have additional light sources to simulate their glow. This creates a more visually striking and impactful effect, drawing the player's attention to these important elements of the environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/6044378bea0e27cdf348697cf27288fdda416394.png[/img]
[b]Skybox and Lighting:[/b] We've started integrating a skybox system that allows us to project diffused light with area pattern, creating more realistic effects. This simulates the way light behaves in real-world environments, such as caves and underground tunnels. The skybox also helps to create a more inviting and believable sense of place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/e2011bfb46e81c80b6c6d8bb190179b3fbb999dc.png[/img]
By incorporating these new lighting and rendering techniques, we've created a more visually stunning and engaging experience that brings The Book of Aaru to life.


[b]Key improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Ambient lighting for a more immersive atmosphere
[*] Dynamic shadows for increased realism
[*] Enhanced emissive materials for visually striking effects
[*] Advanced reflection and refraction for a more connected environment
[*] Skybox system for a more believable sense of place
[/list]

notes.title: Glyph Perk System: A Deep Dive & Graphical Update
notes.content:
[b]Get ready to dive deeper[/b] into the world of Glyphs! We've revamped our perk system with fresh visuals and enhanced descriptions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/a7003f5d39e587fa4f8288912e7c0194d3c19010.png[/img]
[h3]What’s new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each Glyph now has its own unique icon that matches its specific ability.
[*] Hand-designed icons are made to be easily recognizable.
[*] Icons more closely represent the category and purpose of each upgrade.
[/list]
[h3]How our perk system works? 
[/h3]

[b]Application[/b] categorizes Glyphs into five types:

[list]
[*] [b]Are you an offensive powerhouse?[/b] Unleash devastating attacks with Offensive Glyphs.
[*] [b]Prefer a defensive stance?[/b] Defensive Glyphs provide protective bonuses, such as reducing damage received from dangerous traps scattered throughout the depths of Aaru.
[*] [b]Want a versatile arsenal?[/b] Utility Glyphs offer a wide array of abilities, from combat rewards after successful parries to lightning attacks jumping between enemies activated by well performed combos.
[*] [b]Looking to strike it rich?[/b] Increase your chances of finding valuable treasures or larger quantities of them or gain a chance to receive bonus rewards for your spent currency with Riches Glyphs!
[*] [b]Ready to bend time to your will?[/b] Time Altering Glyphs enhance your ability to Bend Time, for example enabling you to unleash a powerful shockwave when this unique ability is activated.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/95f5d0bcac1a6f1385e2d27c2cfb667e887ddc07.png[/img]
[b]Risk[/b] divides Glyphs into three tiers,
but remember, every choice comes with a downfall. Stat-based Glyphs offer subtle enhancements, while Gameplay Altering Glyphs unlock new abilities or evolve existing ones. [b]Dare to take higher risk?[/b] Two-edged Glyphs provide powerful benefits but also come with drawbacks.

[list]
[*] [b]Stat-based:[/b] These Glyphs provide passive, low-risk enhancements, subtly boosting your abilities in the background - like increasing your chance to deal critical damage or heighten your stamina recovery.
[*] [b]Gameplay altering:[/b] These Glyphs unlock new abilities or evolve existing ones. As a result, they carry a moderate risk as your skill level will determine how effectively you can harness these enhancements.
[*] [b]Two-edged:[/b] These Glyphs offer high-risk, high-reward perks. They significantly boost your character in one aspect but also make you weaker in another. For example, with a curse of Seth your attacks will gain immense power, but you'll need to engage in constant combat or you start losing your health.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788407/96a7548267cecef2bec5daabda265bd0f5a60e1b.png[/img]
[h3][b]Choose wisely and tailor your Glyph loadout to fit your playstyle![/b][/h3]
